custom_image.note: your own image, supervised by the platform: its entrypoint never runs (the platform keeps the node alive for run_command), and only the home path survives stops - everything else resets every wake

calendar.note: Fridays 33% off, weekends 20% off (US Pacific) - applied to the minutes that run on those days, not locked at create

stopped.note: work ended and nothing attached within the idle grace window, so the node auto-stopped and parked its disk (files survive; processes ended). run_command wakes it - and hold_node keeps it awake while you work on it across several turns, which is what to reach for if this stop landed mid-task

wake_estimate.estimate_basis: queue from 117 recent cpu-8 wake departures over 7d; spin-up from 2 cpu-8 wake samples; no recent wake history for this shape
wake_estimate.note: what a wake requested right now would be quoted, from the wake queue as it stands - a reading, not a reservation; conditions at your actual wake may differ, and a wake when the shape has capacity free is near-immediate. Wakes are served before creates. If this disk holds the only copy of files you will need soon, weigh this number before relying on a stop/wake round trip - snapshot_node or export_data keeps a durable copy a wake never has to wait for.
